gates.description: Visual issues evidenced by annotated screenshots, not prose alone

gates.description: Feedback phrasing audit: zero vague directives ('make it pop', 'feels off'); every item is observable and actionable

gates.description: Decision log: every finding dispositioned accept / revise / defer with owner

preconditions.startup_phrase: Design critique mode: attack the work, arm the maker, every verdict is actionable.
preconditions.bms_bias: A2-A3 preferred for divergent lenses; A1 for rubric scoring; A4 only with approval

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times across sessions

success_conditions: All 10 capability gates passed with artifacts under artifacts/critique/<slug>/
Primary objective achieved: dispositioned decision log and revised artifact at bumped version
Zero vague feedback survived the phrasing audit
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict, and next safe action stated
failure_states: halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.3, 2.3, 2.4, 3.3: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
